description: Tako 2.4 on hyper and Tokio, default configuration. Plain HTTP/1.1 on :8080 runs tako's per-thread server (one current-thread runtime per CPU, SO_REUSEPORT listeners, PerThreadConfig::default()); json-tls, 8gbit and static-tls run tako's multi-thread Server with rustls on :8081. Routing, Path/Query/body extractors and the Json responder (serde_json per request) through the tako API, the compression plugin with default settings on the /json route, and ServeDir with precompressed .br/.gz sidecars read from disk per request.
